units.source_text: 凡是不知实情的人，她绝不让他们知道，戒备得非常周密。

en.t: She would never let anyone who did not know the truth find out, and kept guard with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 两人互相告道：“过了几时之后，自当把小姐寻死的情由悄悄地告知大将和亲王。

en.t: The two said to each other, "After some time has passed, we should quietly tell the General and the Prince why the young lady tried to take her own life.

units.source_text: 现在就让他们知道，反会减却他们的哀情。

en.t: If we let them know now, it would only lessen their grief.

units.source_text: 所以目下倘有人走漏风声，我们对不起死者。”

en.t: So if anyone lets the matter slip just now, we will have wronged the dead."

units.source_text: 这两人心中负疚甚深，所以尽力隐瞒。

en.t: These two felt a deep burden of guilt in their hearts, and so they did everything they could to keep it hidden.
